messages:
samah (new hire): hey team — second day here, quick Q about Notion: where should i keep my "first-2-weeks" checklist so my manager can review it without me exposing my private notes? also i can't duplicate the onboarding template, says request needed.

leo (DevEx): welcome! put personal drafts in your Private space by default. For manager review create a copy under /Company Home/Onboarding/Shared-Drafts/<team> and share with your manager as Can comment or Can edit.

samah (new hire): sounds good. how do i move a page from Private to that Shared-Drafts folder? i tried drag and drop and got a permissions popup.

people-ops-bot: If you see permission errors moving Notion pages, file an access request: https://redwood.internal/access-requests with the page URL and target location. People Ops and Docs will approve.

anya (Docs): @samah I checked — your account exists but you aren't in the 'onboard-editors' group required to duplicate templates with automation blocks. I can create a team copy for you if People Ops confirms your team.

ravi (eng manager): confirmed, samah is on infra. @anya please go ahead and grant a copy or add samah to onboard-editors. For review flow: manager sets checklist to Can comment during edits, then switches to Can edit when ready to sign off.

anya (Docs): done — added samah to onboard-editors and also created a copy under /Company Home/Onboarding/Shared-Drafts/infra/samah-first-2-weeks. You should see the page now.

samah (new hire): i can access it, thanks! any naming rules for these drafts? we have a lot of forks.

leo (DevEx): please use this pattern: <Team> - <YourName> - OnboardChecklist - (draft) then when published: <Team> - <YourName> - OnboardChecklist - vYYYY.MM.DD. Add page props: Owner, Team, StartDate, Manager, Status.

samah (new hire): perfect. last tiny Q — People Ops wants a central record. should managers add a link somewhere when done?

ravi (eng manager): yes, add the final link to /Company Home/Onboarding/Completed-Onboards and set Status to Published and CompletedDate. People Ops picks it up from there.

samah (new hire): done and shared the link with ravi. thanks everyone! :smile:

people-ops-bot: Reminder: to transfer page ownership or enable automations (Slack reminders/HR sync) open https://redwood.internal/access-requests and include page URL and desired owner/integration.
